about_short_description.short_description: Evidently AI is an information technology firm that offers an open-source software tool that provides machine learning models in production.

product.name: Evidently Open-Source Python Library
product.description: An open-source Python library for evaluating, testing, and monitoring machine learning and LLM systems with over 100 pre-made metrics and customizable evaluations.

product.name: Evidently Cloud
product.description: A cloud-based collaborative AI observability platform for teams to evaluate, test, and monitor AI-powered systems with role-based access and no-code workflows.

product.name: LLM Evaluation and Testing Platform
product.description: A platform to generate test cases, run automated evaluations, and monitor large language model systems for accuracy, safety, and quality.

product.name: AI Agent Testing Platform
product.description: A platform to test, debug, and optimize AI agents and multi-step workflows through simulated interactions and automated evaluations.

product.name: LLM Readiness Risk Assessment Service
product.description: A consulting service to assess AI risks, design tailored test strategies, and build production-ready evaluation processes for LLM products.

identifier.value: LLM Benchmarks and Evaluation Datasets Database

product.name: LLM Benchmarks and Evaluation Datasets Database
product.description: A curated database of 200 standardized benchmarks and datasets to evaluate and compare large language model capabilities across various domains.
